walkthroughs.body_html:
Move magnet near coil -> emf induced.

Faster motion or more turns -> bigger emf.

Spinning coil in field induces alternating emf.

UK mains 50 Hz.

AC in primary -> changing flux -> emf in secondary.

Iron core links them.
